evidence.observation: O2 rising monotonically through growth: 12.0→16.0→20.7→27.2 ppm vs ~6-7 ppm baseline at end of ramp
Tube pressure creeping up 3.04→3.21 Torr while Ar flow is steady at ~100 sccm
MFC steady at setpoint, so pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature control at setpoint (749.8 °C), heater power normal — not a thermal fault

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/P trend (or a flow-off pressure-rise / leak-check test) to confirm air ingress rather than a transient outgassing burst from the hot zone
